title: Red Hat Security Advisory: flatpak security update
description: Two security vulnerabilities in Flatpak, a system for sandboxed Linux desktop applications, allow arbitrary file deletion and arbitrary file write in root context via path traversal in specific deploy directories. These issues are identified as CVE-2026-97023 and CVE-2026-97024. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing these flaws in Flatpak for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.4 variants.
